title: CRM - Desk Integration | No notice to the admin when the initial sync finishes
env: staging-desk.taviportal.com · tenant NDC-Staging · Edge (headless) · account mahmoud.mahamed1515 (Desk Administrator)

panels.caption: After Disconnect + Connect the admin's bell has two "CRM SYNC RUN" notices for the initial imports.
The notice has added / updated / could-not-sync counts, but not the 14 skipped, and the Failure Log it points to has none of the records.
Failure Log after the reconnect (11:05 local): still 19 entries, the newest from 10:30 — the 7 records of this run are not listed.

rows: Admin told when initial sync is done
2 bell notices ("CRM customer/contract sync finished: …") within seconds of the runs
"0 added, 0 updated, 5 could not sync" — 14 skipped (ignored) customers missing
Notice says "The Failure Log lists the records that could not sync" — none of the 7 are there; no reasons anywhere
Truncated to "…finished: 0 added, …" in the list
Not checked — no access to the admin mailbox
Config identical to the backup except import timestamps
